summary: Lewis Hamilton faces a redemption arc at Circuit of the Americas as Kimi Antonelli arrives within striking distance of the world championship after Singapore's strategic collapse. McLaren hunts damage control while Ferrari capitalizes on the momentum shift, with every pit stop decision scrutinized under the weight of Hamilton's costly misstep. A Antonelli triumph would seal the title and reshape the 2024 championship narrative around the rising star rather than the veteran's comeback campaign.
